findings.finding_id: P1-1 redirect failures that urllib rejects before the redirect handler runs (non-http Location scheme; malformed or invalid bracketed-host Location) must raise a redacted AdapterError 'from None' so that no message, __cause__, __context__ or traceback exposes the Location URL or Location query data; add offline tests for both cases that fail on the repair base and pass on the result
